notes.title: Just In Time For Halloween, Spooky Mystery Whodunit Is Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/bfafed816a6a7903571576b1dcf456bb986b04af.png[/img]

[b]Put your detective hat on and solve the untimely murder of a famous video game designer.[/b]

A fabulously wealthy game designer is found dead outside his castle in rural Vermont, and soon evidence shows that this was not merely a freak accident attributed to local superstition. Now it's up to you to investigate the murder and apprehend the guilty. Play as unlikely partners -- ace sleuth Detective Guy and Cleo, the clue-sniffing dog to explore the castle grounds, search for clues, and question suspects. Can you solve the case?
[list]
[*] Murder mystery whodunit
[*] Play as a detective and dog crime-solving team
[*] Explore the area and look for clues
[*] Interview suspects and make deductions
[*] Solve the case and apprehend the guilty
[/list]
“I’m excited to share “Murder Is Game Over” with gamers and mystery fans everywhere. I hope players enjoy the exploration mechanics, spooky atmosphere, and classically-inspired whodunit story,” said Matthew of HitherYon Games. 

[b]Murder Is Game Over[/b] is 20% off until November 1. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940090/Murder_Is_Game_Over

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4 is applied.
notes.content:
Phew, finally we created the patch that locks the fps rate at 60. Most people try to increase their fps whereas we had to decrease it )

So, no more processors heating and boiling. This particular game may use a bit more resources than an average visual novel because we have quite a few animations and some complex visual effects. 

Few misprints are taken care of too. Thanx for supporting us and letting us make your gameplay experience better!

notes.title: 2st Patch
notes.content:
The second patch is here. We're still doing some amendments which are going to improve gaming experience. 

1) The "last save is fixed". When you complete the game, you can now load the game from the last save.

2) The music is playing while at the loading screen now

3) Space bar now removes first the dialogue box and then the characters if pressed for the second time.

4) Few typos are corrected.

5) Now the player can immediately reply the battle if lost (the feature long been asked by the community). 

6) The 5th music track is added.

Please report any bugs or glitches that may occur during your playthrough so we can make the game even better. Thank you for your kind support.

notes.title: 1st Patch
notes.content:
The first patch (1.0.1) is here. Minor changes, but still important:

1) Fixed the Brawler achievement. Now it pops up after the last battle, not before.

2) The default language now corresponds with the language that is set for your Steam.

3) Some sounds are played at the spots they were meant to be played. They're n'sync with the action now.

4) Reduced the area for choosing an option during dialogue. Now you won't accidentally choose something you didn't really want to.
